Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 30 minutes Total time: 40 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Ingredients 2 medium or 3 small zucchini 1/2 cup tomato based pasta sauce 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 2 Tablespoons parmesan cheese Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Heat oven to 350 °F. Cut each zucchini in half lengthwise. Use a spoon to gently scrape out soft, seedy center of zucchini. Place zucchini halves in a small baking dish. Spoon pasta sauce into zucchini halves. Top with mozzarella and parmesan cheeses. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until zucchini can be pierced with a fork and cheese is bubbly and brown. Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
